title: Multi-unit packs follow the canonical variant naming pattern
remediation: Set the variant tab to `<pack>x <size>` and align the trailing variant name/short-name suffix to the same canonical pack label.
workflow: Emit a janitorial review row per affected variant, then apply via a packet-driven `store.product.edit` pass after approval.

title: Edibles do not surface potency/prevalence percentage data
remediation: Use the edible THC prevalence review packet to remove storefront percentage-style potency labels while keeping reviewed amount displays such as `10x 10mg`.
workflow: Treat edible potency rows as a dedicated janitorial lane; do not add or preserve prevalence-style potency data on edible catalog rows.

title: No in-scope cannabis catalog entry remains attached to a disabled subcategory
remediation: Clear the product-group `subcategoryId` unless a reviewed enabled replacement has already been approved.
workflow: Emit one janitorial review row per affected group, then apply with `store.product.group.edit { id, subcategoryId: null }` after approval.

title: Every in-scope cannabis catalog entry has an image
remediation: Route the group into the existing image review/backfill workflow; prefer exact product imagery first, and only surface clearly labeled same-brand placeholder-grade imagery as a temporary fallback when no exact image can be found. Do not auto-invent or auto-apply an image.
workflow: Use the janitorial packet to surface missing-image groups and hand them off to the established image review lane, keeping exact-product and placeholder-grade brand proposals reviewer-visible and separate.

title: Every in-scope cannabis catalog price lands on an even $0.25 increment
remediation: Flag any missing or non-quarter global price and propose the nearest quarter-dollar target for review.
workflow: Treat quarter-rounding as a janitorial pricing review lane; metrics should count only actual variant hits, not raw scanned rows.

title: Vape `All In One / Disposable` subcategory requires explicit AIO evidence
remediation: Clear the vape product-group `subcategoryId` whenever the row currently reads `All In One / Disposable` but the product is actually a 510 cartridge or any other non-self-contained device. Null is preferred over a wrong AIO label because mislabeling a 510 cart as AIO causes spoiled-product refunds when customers without a 510 battery try to use it.
workflow: Flag any in-stock vape group whose live subcategory is `All In One / Disposable` without independent vendor evidence of an integrated battery (`disposable`, `AIO`, `Briq`, `puff bar`, `USB-C`, `battery life`); apply with `store.product.group.edit { id, subcategoryId: null }` from state context. See `docs/sweed/catalog/creation-and-editing.md` for the full asymmetry rule and `automation/individual_catalog_fixes/clear_house_of_sacci_vape_subcategories.py` for the brand-scoped template.

title: Fake inventory barcodes trigger a loud alarm

midtown.reason: Barcode rollout is already in flight for Midtown. Hide janitorial alarm noise until May 1.

bronx.reason: Barcode rollout is already in flight for Bronx. Hide janitorial alarm noise until May 3.

remediation: Escalate immediately when any in-stock package barcode starts with the fake `25000...` prefix so the package gets a real barcode ASAP.
workflow: Use the site-level fake-barcode audit packet as an alarm lane; do not silently auto-fix or bury these hits inside generic cleanup metrics.
